meta.description: Comprehensive database for RNS Institute of Technology

college.name: RNS Institute of Technology
college.location: R R Nagar Post, Channasandra, Bengaluru - 560098

canteen.location: Near the sports ground and hostel entrance

gym.details: Separate gym facilities and timings for boys and girls

wifi.details: Campus-wide Wi-Fi available for students and staff

banking.details: Canara Bank extension counter and ATM on campus

programs.phd: VTU Research Centers in CSE, ECE, MECH, CIVIL, CHEM, PHYSICS, MATH, MBA

eligibility.be: Pass in 10+2 / PUC with Physics and Mathematics compulsory, plus one of Chemistry / Biology / Electronics / Computer Science, with the minimum aggregate prescribed by KEA/VTU, and a valid KCET, COMEDK UGET, or JEE Main score.
eligibility.mtech: A relevant B.E./B.Tech degree; GATE score preferred where applicable.
eligibility.mba: A recognized bachelor's degree in any discipline, plus a valid KMAT or equivalent score, followed by group discussion/personal interview.
eligibility.mca: A recognized bachelor's degree with mathematics background, plus a valid Karnataka PGCET or KMAT score.
eligibility.lateral_entry: Diploma holders can join the B.E. second year directly through the Karnataka lateral entry (DCET) process, subject to seat availability in the branch.

process_steps: Check eligibility for the intended course (10+2/diploma/degree requirements).
Register for and appear in the relevant entrance exam: KCET, COMEDK UGET, or JEE Main for B.E.; PGCET/KMAT/GATE for postgraduate programs.
Register on the RNSIT website / respective counselling authority's portal.
After results, participate in centralized counselling (KEA for KCET, COMEDK for COMEDK UGET) for choice filling and seat allotment; management quota candidates apply directly to RNSIT.
Complete document verification once a seat is allotted.
Pay the admission fee as instructed to confirm the seat.
documents_required: KCET / COMEDK / JEE Main rank card and admit card
Category and income certificate (if applicable, for reservation)
Aadhaar card (or passport, for NRI/international applicants)

fees.note: Fees vary significantly by quota and branch and are revised most years — as a rough indicative range, B.E. annual fees have been reported between roughly 1.5 and 7.5 lakh rupees per year depending on quota and branch, with government/KCET-quota seats considerably cheaper than management/COMEDK-quota seats. These figures change year to year, so please confirm the exact current fee for your category and branch with the Admissions Office rather than relying on this as final.

general: Karnataka government scholarships for eligible SC/ST/OBC/minority/economically weaker categories
National Scholarship Portal (NSP) schemes for eligible students
Merit-based fee concessions for top rank holders, where offered by the institute
scholarships.note: Scholarship eligibility and amounts are decided by the government/institute each year — please verify current schemes with the Admissions Office.

faqs.question: Where is the Accounts Manager office?

faqs.question: How can I contact the Admissions department?

faqs.question: Is there a gym on campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, RNSIT has separate gym facilities and timings for boys and girls.

faqs.question: Where is the canteen located?

faqs.question: What are the college working hours?
faqs.answer: The college working hours are 9:20 AM to 5:00 PM on all working days.

faqs.question: Does RNSIT have Wi-Fi?

faqs.question: Where is the Dr. Shivaram Karanth Auditorium?

faqs.question: What are the library timings?

faqs.question: Does the college provide transport?

faqs.question: Is medical help available on campus?

faqs.question: What is the CET code for RNSIT?

faqs.question: How many companies recruit from RNSIT?

faqs.answer: Yes, RNSIT has VTU Research Centers in CSE, ECE, Mechanical, Civil, Chemistry, Physics, Math and MBA.

faqs.question: What are the student clubs at RNSIT?
faqs.answer: RNSIT has clubs including QuizCorp, Google DSC, AdroIT, Big O Coding Club, Placement Club and Aura cultural club.

faqs.question: What is the cultural fest of RNSIT?

faqs.question: What departments does RNSIT have?
faqs.answer: RNSIT offers CSE, ECE, ISE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, AI and ML, CSE Data Science, CSE Cyber Security, AI and DS at UG level, and MBA and MCA at PG level.

faqs.question: Where is RNSIT located?
faqs.answer: RNSIT is located at R R Nagar Post, Channasandra, Bengaluru - 560098.
